layers.process: Kibale National Park, Kanyanchu: the park page says guided chimpanzee tracking groups have at most six visitors and normal viewing lasts one hour. Advance booking is required; verify current arrangements with UWA.

Kanyanchu chimpanzee tracking: UWA sources differ. The park page says minimum age 16 and lists starts at 08:00, 11:00 and 14:00; UWA’s signed July 2024 general tracking guidelines say chimpanzee minimum age 12 and list 08:00 and 14:00. Confirm the applicable age and departure times with UWA.

sources.title: Guidelines for the management of gorilla and chimpanzee tracking, July 2024
sources.supports: national tracking minimum age and start times differ from Kibale page (read directly 2026-11-08)
